title: ClarificationToPOContract
description: Message schema from the Clarification Node to the Product Owner Agent

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the current Claude Code session

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this message was produced

original_input.description: The raw user input as received

clarifications.description: Q&A pairs from clarification rounds. Empty if input was immediately clear.

resolved_scope.description: One paragraph summarizing the clarified request

confidence.description: Confidence level of the clarification. Low confidence must not be routed.
